conditions: There are no component blueprints, dojo research, boss drop, quest, or syndicate gate.
The Fulmin, its blueprint, and Hexenon are untradeable. Fulmin Prime is a separate weapon.

rows.label: Hexenon
rows.alt: Io, Jupiter Defense with a loot squad

conditions: Ganymede round rewards add 5 Hexenon on rotation A, 10 on B, and 15 on C; keep all four conduits alive to reach the C reward.
Resource boosters affect enemy and container pickups, but not the end-of-round Hexenon reward.
A loot frame and Resourceful Retriever substantially improve the enemy-drop portion.
bonuses: Run Jupiter Fissures when possible: the same farm earns relic rewards, prime parts, and Forma.
A Distilling Extractor on Jupiter can passively supplement Hexenon between runs.

disclosures.title: why Ganymede
disclosures.body: Amalgams, including the Demolishers, are good Hexenon targets, and Disruption adds guaranteed round rewards on top of their drops. Io is a useful fallback if you need public squads with a Nekros or another loot frame.

groups.activity: quick Capture runs and break Argon deposits
conditions: Argon begins decaying at GMT 00:00 and the decaying stack halves at each later reset. Collect it immediately before starting the Foundry build.
bonuses: Void Capture runs also provide relics while you search for deposits.

conditions: Mastery Rank 8 is required to equip Fulmin, but does not stop you buying the blueprint or starting its build.
